messages:
releases-bot: Canary rollout started for service=api-gateway config_change=KMS_KEY=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/redwood-prod-v2 canary=10% commit=sha:9f8a7d (initiated by @oliver)
oliver: seeing canary health degrade almost immediately, 502s from token decrypt path
sara: synthetic checks firing, all canary instances returning 502 within 60s :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Paging on-call: @mike — incident created INC-2026-0316-01 (prod-canary-decrypt-fail)
mike: on-call here, joining huddle, looking at logs now
oliver: logs show KMS: AccessDeniedException when attempting to decrypt model_secret, stack trace attached
jyoti: interesting — the key was rotated last night. Did key policy get updated for redwood-runner role?
sara: quick grep shows key policy still references key alias redwood-prod (old) not redwood-prod-v2
mike: can we hotfix by granting kms:Decrypt to the IAM principal used by canary nodes? That should be fastest
jyoti: we can also kill the canary rollout flag to stop traffic to canary while we fix — less risky than immediate IAM change if we want audit trail
oliver: killing canary routing now via rollout console -> set canary_weight=0
releases-bot: Canary traffic set to 0% for service=api-gateway (rollback of rollout stage)
sara: traffic reverted, customer-facing errors stopped, but some queued requests still failing — need to fix root cause before re-enable
mike: i'm going to request a temporary key policy update: grant kms:Decrypt to arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-runner-canary for key redwood-prod-v2 — will add ephemeral permissions and log it
jyoti: policy change applied, aws returned 200 for PutKeyPolicy at 22:11:08Z
oliver: doing a retry of a few failed requests locally — decrypts succeed now, responses are 200
releases-bot: Canary rollback completed and canary flag disabled. No further canary traffic will be routed until manual re-enable
mike: handing off monitoring to daytime on-call @bryan — leaving notes: reverted canary weight, applied temp key policy, root cause likely key-rotation + missing key policy update for service principal
bryan: ack, monitoring for 30m, will escalate if errors reappear
sara: opened INC-2026-0316-01 in ops board, tagging security and infra for postmortem and key policy hardening
jyoti: recommendation: update deploy checklist to include KMS key policy change whenever rotating alias, and add an automated check in deploy pipeline
mike: agreed. I'll draft incident postmortem and link PRs for checklist + IAM automation. Thanks all for quick response :thumbsup:
